verdicts.decision_note: First concrete deployment-state failure: the system was reading from the wrong contract and using a default Anvil address.
Target-specific implementation claim after the wrong-contract failure, with corrected production supply and leaderboard expectations.
Distinct redeployment failure: the USDC mint and site statistics were aligned to inconsistent contract instances.
The client accepts a concrete upgrade strategy that starts active NFT and draw state from the replacement contract while excluding the legacy contract from product systems.
Target-specific implementation transition: the freelancer reports that the product is actively using the replacement contract.
Concrete post-activation failure: dashboard and home-page state remained inconsistently split between wiped and retained data.
The client accepts a safe-redeployment strategy intended to apply contract fixes while retaining current production data; replacing the existing strategy key requires no stale-key removal.
